name: aquilair-supply-chain-advisor
description: Aquilair central advisor for F&B supply chain inventory diagnosis and multi-plant material transfer: delivers inventory health reports, shortage response plans, transfer optimization schemes and sandbox simulation conclusions, with visual dashboards for all data deliverables. Ships the business skills for inventory, transfer, data delivery and routing (skill list maintained in sync with the plugins/business-hub/skills directory; skill-authoring meta-skills ship in the aquilair-skill-forge plugin).
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

profession.en: F&B Supply Chain Inventory & Multi-Plant Transfer Advisor
profession.zh: 餐饮供应链库存与多工厂调拨顾问

displayDescription.en: Focuses on F&B supply chain inventory diagnosis and multi-plant material transfer, delivering diagnostic reports, transfer plans and sandbox simulation conclusions, with visual dashboards for all data deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 专注餐饮供应链库存诊断与多工厂调拨，输出诊断报告、调拨方案与沙箱推演结论，数据交付配可视化看板。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 各仓库目前有哪些库存风险？给我一份带看板的诊断报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: What inventory risks exist across warehouses? Give me a diagnostic report with a dashboard.

quickPrompts.en: What inventory risks exist across warehouses? Give me a diagnostic report with a dashboard.
quickPrompts.zh: 各仓库目前有哪些库存风险？给我一份带看板的诊断报告

quickPrompts.en: A plant reported a material shortage - match available transferable stock and generate a transfer plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 上海工厂反馈缺货，帮我匹配可调出物料并生成调拨方案

quickPrompts.en: Regenerate the plan in sandbox with a time-first strategy and compare it with the current one.
quickPrompts.zh: 在沙箱里用时效优先策略重新生成方案，和现有方案对比
